name: hook-result-protocol
note: hook action result fields: decision allow|deny|block|defer per EVENT_DECISIONS, reason, additional_context, annotations, output

name: hook-events
note: HOOK_EVENTS gains onStop and onTick; onTick action keys interval_seconds and when

name: event-types
note: EVENT_TYPES gains turn_continued, turn_deferred, usage, turn_resumed, destroy_output

name: hook-context-env-vars
note: command action env: full service env plus CCW_STATE_DIR and CCW_API_URL

name: command-request-api
note: SessionRouter.request_command(name, params=None, *, origin agent|client|idle) -> CommandRecord; raises commands.CommandRejected(code, message)

name: ccw-mcp-tool
note: POST /internal/mcp JSON-RPC; one tool command {name: enum of agent allowlist, params?}; claude.json mcpServers.ccw with ${CCW_*} env refs; allow rule mcp__ccw__command

name: commands-endpoint
note: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/commands {name, args?} -> 202 record; GET list and GET {command_id}

name: peers-config
note: Config.peers: enabled (false), name (empty = hostname, [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}, not . or .. or leading dot), advertise_url (empty = http://<hostname>:<public port>, {port} placeholder), token (required when enabled, >=16 chars, != server.auth_token, redacted, signing key only), static (seed urls, strings or {url}; ccw serve --peer extends), heartbeat_seconds (10), max_missed_heartbeats (3), join_timeout_seconds (10), max_message_bytes (65536), inbox_max (32), max_clock_skew_seconds (60), max_messages_per_minute (30)

name: peer-directory-entry
note: RETIRED: shared-folder discovery was dropped by the user in favour of join/leave membership (see peer-member-table); nothing implements or reads this

name: ccw-mcp-peers-tool
note: ccw MCP tools peers {instance?} -> [{address, instance, session_id, name, cwd}] and send_message {to, message, notify_when_idle?} -> msg_id or error (unknown peer, peer unreachable, message too large, inbox full, rate limited, peer rejected the request, invalid arguments); listed only when peers.enabled; allow rules mcp__ccw__peers, mcp__ccw__send_message; handle_message(router, message, peers=None) is async

name: peer-messages-endpoint
note:
Signed routes under /v1/peers: messages {from, to_session, message, msg_id, notify_when_idle} 202; notices {from, to_session, msg_id, status delivered|rejected|dropped, state, reason} 202; join and heartbeat {instance, url, sessions, members} 200 with the receiver view; leave {instance, url} 204. Headers X-CCW-Peer-Timestamp (unix ms), X-CCW-Peer-Nonce, X-CCW-Peer-Signature = HMAC-SHA256(token, METHOD
path
timestamp
nonce
sha256(body)); skew max_clock_skew_seconds, replayed nonce rejected; 401 unauthorized, 404 not_found, 413 message_too_large, 422, 429 inbox_full|rate_limited; body capped at max_message_bytes + 4096 before parse; mounted only when peers.enabled

name: peer-member-table
note: Membership view exchanged by join and heartbeat: {instance, url, sessions: [{session_id, name, cwd}], members: [{instance, url}]}; sessions trusted only from a member's own report, members gossip contacts only; reachable after a direct exchange, dropped after max_missed_heartbeats misses or a leave; address <instance>/<session id>
